topic.title: SF dating: emotionally available. In private beta.
topic.context: AI agents can help with shopping, bookings and business phone calls; Google announced agentic shopping and store calling in November 2025. The cultural debate is whether outsourcing life also outsources having a personality. SF startup dating, pickleball networking and monotone pitch-deck small talk are comic satire, not sourced claims about every resident. No named person or invented news. Would you let AI write your dating messages, or would two agents end up dating each other?
topic.opening: In San Francisco, even flirting sounds like a product demo. Emotionally available? Currently in private beta. Would you let an AI handle your dating life?
